status: investigation-only; no production site or Help mutation

content.help_contract: internal/helpdocs.Seed reads the same docs directory; the prototype stages each Markdown file byte-for-byte and never edits docs or Help notes

urls.current_builder_finding: Marked emits no heading IDs in the current command, so source fragment links do not resolve; this is a measured current-pipeline defect, not a Ledger regression

runtime_smoke.keyboard: theme controls, mobile drawer open, and Escape close passed
runtime_smoke.qualification: Executable smoke samples, not a complete WCAG audit

build_measurements.host: local development host; single observed run, not a performance acceptance gate

repeat_build.finding: Pagefind 1.5.2 assigned different hashed metadata/index shard names on two builds while both indexed 15 pages and 3191 words and passed the same Argon2id query. Reproducibility therefore means pinned source/tools plus validated routes, scope, counts, and search behavior; it does not claim a byte-for-byte Pagefind tree.

build_measurements.interpretation: The current builder invokes npx Marked separately for every page; observed time includes local tool resolution overhead and is not a product benchmark. Prototype size varies by a few bytes with Pagefind's hashed shard partition and remains a small static bundle.
